pr.title: Rename project question to project inbox
pr.head: 5ce88b153fb8593248f94bc5d2db2d6caf5cc094

summary: Projector lets an agent ask you a question without stopping its work. The agent runs project question ask, or calls the ask tool in Claude Code. The question waits in a per-session store on disk, Projector's band above the Claude Code prompt shows it, and your answer goes back to the agent that asked. Release 0.7.14 shipped this.

The inbox plan adds a second kind of item, a notice: something an agent tells you that needs no answer. Once notices exist, the command and its store hold more than questions. This pull request is the plan's first layer. It renames everything now, while nobody depends on the old names, and changes no behavior. The second layer, #279, adds notices and snoozing.
Nothing migrates. project question becomes an unknown command that exits 2. The CLI never reads the old projector/questions/ directory, so any such directory stays on disk untouched.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• A full Projector review of d3661d2 found the head clean, with no finding threads. The full gate passed: 883 Python tests with 1 skip, plan check, both plugin validations, and 51 hook tests.
  • It suggested renaming the question parameter of print_item in src/projector/cli.py. 5ce88b1 made that rename, and an incremental review of it found the head clean.

groups.title: The store and the CLI
groups.kicker: The Python module and command that keep each session's items
intro: src/projector/inbox.py (formerly questions.py) keeps each session's items as one JSON file per item in a directory under Projector's state directory. cli.py exposes it as project inbox, with the same subcommands, flags, and exit codes as before.
The record's field names change here, so this group is the contract the band below reads. Every record this layer writes has kind: "question"; the next layer adds notice.

checks.text: In a scratch XDG_STATE_HOME, project inbox ask wrote q1 under projector/inbox/s1/ with kind, postedAt, and subject, no projector/questions/ directory appeared, and project question list exited 2.

files.note: The module renamed from questions.py: the store root, error classes, helpers, and the record's field names.

checks.text: The store root moves here. Nothing reads projector/questions/ any more, so an existing session's old questions disappear from every view, and numbering restarts at 1 in the new directory. The plan accepts both.
Every record now carries kind. Functions that only make sense for questions, such as answer, claim, and typed_letter, keep question as their variable name on purpose.

files.note: The question command group becomes inbox, printing item and items in its JSON.
The existing tests under the new names, plus two new ones: the record's new shape and store directory, and the old command exiting 2.

checks.text: This test pins the record's new fields and checks that the old store directory is never created.

groups.title: The band in Claude Code
groups.kicker: The hooks module that shows items above the prompt and delivers answers
intro: Projector's band is a strip above the Claude Code prompt, drawn by the hooks module in hooks/. It lists the session's items, lets you answer them, and delivers each answer to the agent that asked. It reads and changes the store only by running the CLI, so here every project question call becomes project inbox and every field read follows the renamed record.
The band keeps some state in the session across a plugin reload. The list of items moves to a new key, bandInbox, which starts empty after an update and fills on the next read of the store.

checks.text: claude plugin test . passed all 51 hook tests at this head. The fake CLI in band.test.tsx refuses any command group but inbox, so a leftover project question call would fail there.

files.note: Question becomes Item, with kind, postedAt, and subject; the state key becomes bandInbox.

checks.text: kind is the literal type 'question' for now. The next layer widens it to include 'notice'.

files.note: Pure helpers, renamed from questions.ts: the store path, the arguments for project inbox ask, and the field reads.

checks.text: This path must match the CLI's store_root in src/projector/inbox.py, since the band lists this directory to decide when to run the CLI.

files.note: Every CLI call, JSON read, state key, and drawer key under the new names.

checks.text: A delivery the band had in flight during a plugin update stays in bandSending with a ref and token from the old store. Renewing or settling it fails against the new store, and the existing code ignores those failures.
Drawer keys change from question: to item:, so a drawer open across an update closes. Nothing else reads the old prefix.

groups.title: The plans
groups.kicker: Closing the questions plan and starting the inbox plan
intro: Projector keeps each project's plan under docs/projects/, with a status in its frontmatter. The questions plan, which shipped project question, moves to completed with an outcome section. The inbox plan moves from ready to in-progress because this pull request starts it.

checks.text: Each of the five open questions in the questions plan's § 7 appears, renamed, among the first five bullets of the inbox plan's § 7, so closing the questions plan leaves none untracked.

files.note: Status completed, and a new § 9 recording that it shipped in #271 and #273 and continues as inbox.

checks.text: § 9, Outcome. The plan's body above still says project question; this section tells a reader that the commands now run under project inbox.
